name: 白金奖杯指南（难度/时长/可错过点）
prerequisites: 搬运自 PowerPyx，小黑盒用户翻译校对
steps: 奖杯难度：4/10（无难度奖杯、无金牌要求、无线上杯，只考验时间）
一周目时长 60-80 小时；白金总时长 150-200 小时
最难点：奖杯「漫漫长路」（完成 100% 收集度）
通关后获得 100% 收集清单；实际只需完成约 60% 游戏内容（绝大部分支线不用做完）
100% 需扫描 277 款基础车型里的 200 款（船只飞机也记得扫）
100% 需观察 255 种动物里的 100 种（不同品种猫狗分开算，只需观察不用剥皮）
可选任务总量 200-300+，远超所需；建议一刷出来就做
唯一疑似可错过：第一章杰森家冥想点——完成任务「如梦方醒」后早上在厨房与露西娅对话，跟随她到阳台完成冥想（教程点位，计入清单但不标注）
cautions: 官方口径核对：全奖杯 55 个（1 白金+2 金+6 银+46 铜），55 条逐条条目已全部收录
道德度系统（犯罪档案）与奖杯无关，只影响 NPC 攻击力度；彻底变坏无法挽回名誉
露西娅和杰森好感度与奖杯无关
完成第一章会自动扣除你获得的所有钱，第一章内不用攒钱
建议每章开始/结束存档（本作无任务重玩机制）
全成就逐条清单知识库尚未收录（成就总数未核对），本条是策略向指南

name: 漫漫长路
steps: Attain 100% Completion.

The 100% checklist is unlocked after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. Nothing toward 100% is missable, everything is doable after the story in free-roam. The requirements are very forgiving, it’s not a true 100% completion. The majority of collectible types and side quests aren’t required at all. Of the collectibles and activities that are required you typically only need 70-80%. Overall the 100% completion checklist is closer to 60% true completion. Time-Savers: Complete all Optional Missions as they appear. You need to complete any 100 Optional Missions for the 100% Completion Checklist (there are more than needed). Optional Missions include the purple icons and the black icons with pink letters (whereas main missions are pink icons with black letters). Each of the vehicle deliveries of Moses and Randy counts too. Each Meditation Spot counts as +2 if you do it with both Jason and Lucia. There are a few missable optional missions during the story, but it doesn’t matter because there are much more than 100 optional missions total (easily 200-300+). You will automatically get 100+ optional tasks while working on all other trophies. It’s still good doing everything at the earliest opportunity as the optional questlines often introduce you to new game features. Scan any new vehicles you come across using the Waink app by holding and then (automatic unlock in Chapter 1). For 100% Completion you need to scan any 200 of the 277 base model vehicles. If you start it early you will get it done naturally throughout the story. Also scan boats and aircraft. Study any new animals you come across using the binoculars. Hold to select binoculars from weapon wheel, zoom in with and hold to study. For 100% Completion you need to study any 100 of 255 animals. Every breed of dog and cat counts separately too. Unlike Red Dead Redemption 2 you don’t need to hunt and skin the animals, just studying any 100 of them is enough. » GTA 6 – 100% Completion Checklist & Guide

Garages become available for purchase after Chapter 2 – Main Mission: Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) . You will receive a notification that a new app has been installed on your phone, called Vice City Real Estate. You simply buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make money is to do robberies, especially later in Chapters 3-4 when you unlock higher-value robberies. » GTA 6 All 12 Garage Locations
